camel_example: aliyun cbn ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments --region cn-hangzhou --TransitRouterAttachmentId 'tr-attach-oyf70wfuorwx870000' --Tag.1.Key tagtest --NextToken dd200000 --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value tagtest --CenId 'cen-j3jzhw1zpau2km0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TransitRouterId 'tr-bp1su1ytdxtataupl0000'
description_en: Queries the connection information of virtual border routers (VBRs) under an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the total number of entries, connection status, connection IDs, and payers of network instances
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的边界路由器VBR总条目数、连接的状态、连接 ID、网络实例的付费方等连接信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-vbr-attachments --cen-id cen-j3jzhw1zpau2km0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-oyf70wfuorwx870000 --transit-router-id tr-bp1su1ytdxtataupl0000 --max-results 20 --next-token dd200000 --tag Value=tagtest Key=tagtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VBR connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en: The Enterprise Edition forward routing instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的最大条目数。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的最大条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Enterprise Edition forward routing automatically publishes route entries to the VBR instance. Valid values:

false: The Enterprise Edition forward routing does not automatically publish route entries to the VBR instance.
true: The Enterprise Edition forward routing automatically publishes route entries to the VBR instance
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_zh:
企业版转发路由器是否自动发布路由到VBR实例。

false：否。
true：是

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the VBR connection was created.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
CreationTime.description_zh:
VBR连接的创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ

ManagedService.description_en: The cloud service that manages the VBR connection. This parameter is returned only when the VBR connection is managed by a cloud service. The standard code of the cloud service is returned. If the VBR connection is managed by you, this parameter is not returned
ManagedService.description_zh: 标识该VBR连接被哪个云服务托管。只有该VBR连接被云服务托管时才会返回对应云服务的标准Code；如果是您自行管理的VBR连接，则不返回该字段值

OrderType.description_en:
The payer of the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The connection fee and data processing fee of the VBR instance are paid by the account to which the transit router instance belongs.
PayByResourceOwner: The connection fee and data processing fee of the VBR instance are paid by the account to which the VBR instance belongs
OrderType.description_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示VBR实例的连接费和流量处理费由转发路由器实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示VBR实例的连接费和流量处理费由VBR实例所属的账号承担

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of resource to which the connection belongs.

The value is VBR, which indicates a virtual border router instance
ResourceType.description_zh:
连接所属的资源类型。

仅取值：VBR，表示边界路由器实例

Status.description_en:
The status of the VBR connection. Valid values:

Attached: The VBR connection is attached.
Attaching: The VBR connection is being attached.
Detaching: The VBR connection is being detached
Status.description_zh:
VBR连接的状态。

Attached：已加载。
Attaching：加载中。
Detaching：卸载中

TransitRouterAttachmentDescription.description_en: The description of the VBR connection

TransitRouterAttachmentId.description_en: The ID of the VBR connection

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_en: The name of the VBR connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The Enterprise Edition forward routing instance ID
TransitRouterId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID

VbrOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the account to which the VBR instance belongs

VbrRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the VBR instance
